# motif — Design Token Generator

> A zero-configuration web tool for vibe-coding AI developers.

## What it does
motif lets developers instantly visualize "best practice" UI design system templates
(colors, typography, spacing, border radius), tweak them visually, and export the
result as AI-friendly formats: a Markdown rules file, JSON design tokens,
CSS custom properties, or Tailwind config.

## Who it's for
Vibe Coders and AI Developers who are starting a new project and need a fast way
to establish a consistent visual direction before asking their AI agent to build the UI.

## Tech Stack
- Frontend: Vite 6 + React 18 + TypeScript
- Styling: Vanilla CSS with CSS custom properties
- Package manager: pnpm
- No backend — 100% client-side
- Analytics: PostHog EU (anonymous usage events, no cookies, no PII)

## Core Entities
- Theme: a named design system configuration (colors, typography, spacing, border radius)
- ExportedDesignRules: the generated output artifact (MD/JSON/CSS/TW v3/TW v4 string, downloaded as a file)

## Key Files
- src/data/variants.ts           — 10 built-in design system style variants
- src/types/theme.ts             — TypeScript types for all design tokens (44 tokens)
- src/utils/export.ts            — export generation (MD, JSON, CSS, Tailwind v3, Tailwind v4)
- docs/data-maps/THEME_DATA_MAP.md — the data contract
